positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Sub contractor at Salient CRGT (LIST Innovative Solutions, Inc.)
•	Participated in the requirement analysis and design for software releases to support multiple systems at Patient Trademark Office. Implemented, unit tested, and documented the changes in Spring framework using J2EE technology, JavaScript, EJB 3 in JBoss, Oracle and Eclipse. 
•	Implemented changes to generate reports from database and xml files.
•	Modified to the xml validation modules for xml upload web services. 
•	Worked in an Agile development approach to understand requirements, daily scrum meeting, sprint schedule for product supports

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Participated in the requirement analysis and design for software releases to support a change requests tracking system at Department of Justice. Implemented, unit tested, and documented the changes using J2EE technology, JavaScript, EJB 3 in JBoss, Oracle and Eclipse. 
•	Implemented changes to xml tags within export file creation that were creating false positives so that files can be read by Purifile (file inspection tool).
•	Participated in the refactor the application to work with Jboss 7.x that includes replace/upgrade third-party dependencies that conflict with the new JBoss, modification to existing code necessary to the third-party upgrade.  Converted queries to work with Hibernate4.

positions.title: Sr Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Successfully designed, implemented and tested important new capabilities to the Legal Demand Services administrative GUI using J2EE technology including JSF 2.0, JavaScript, AJAX, EJB 3 and PrimeFaces 3.
•	Sketched and prototyped new user web application screens using scrolling, paginated and nested visual display tables using JSF 2.0, AJAX and PrimeFaces 3.
•	Used JUnit, Selenium and other testing frameworks to create detailed unit, integration and application tests to help ensure a high degree of correctness of completed system.
•	Implemented a sophisticated data analysis module for validating system SOAP requests and determining closest matches in case of failure.
•	Enhanced the software communications module to an external (3rd party) web service to meet new requirements and improved service throughput by partitioning JMS queuing service.
•	Used JPS 2 with MS SQL Server to create application data model as well as the EAO layer with application-specific queries.
